subject: Next steps: deployment preference and migration constraints (Medsys Health)
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Jane Li <jane.li@medsys.ai>, Alex Torres <alex.torres@medsys.ai>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo notes + deployment options recap (Medsys)

Hi Jane / Alex —

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap from our side and a suggested set of next steps so we can narrow hosting choice and migration path:

Summary of deployment lanes (one-sentence):
- Hosted API: fastest to production, minimal operational overhead, best if you’re okay with managed keys and our multi-tenant control plane.
- Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pools, predictable throughput and isolation, works well when you need sustained traffic or custom latency SLOs.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): customer-managed network and keys, for regulated PHI/PII use cases or strict data residency.

Migration considerations we discussed:
- If you’re coming from an external LLM API (e.g., vendor X), we can map prompts and tokenization differences and run A/B comparisons.
- For self-hosted / legacy GPU clusters, we typically recommend a staged cutover: pilot on Dedicated (mirror traffic), then cut traffic over to Private or Hosted depending on security needs.

Open questions for you (please reply inline where useful):
1) Primary requirement: data residency (does Medsys need customer-managed keys / VPC?)
2) Cutover tolerance: can you accept a 2–4 week mirror phase?
3) Migration support: do you want Redwood to handle model conversion + KV cache migration or will internal infra team run that?
4) Procurement constraints: any fixed-term/PO requirements or integrations (DocuSign, SSO) we should surface now?

Next steps I propose:
- You share the internal constraints doc (if available) and a preferred pilot timeline.
- We provide a short SOW for a 6-week pilot (Dedicated capacity) that includes migration assistance (if requested) and cost projection.
- Technical touchpoint: schedule a 60-minute runbook/ops call with your infra lead to walk cutover and networking.

Attached: Redwood-Hosting-Options.pdf (compact comparison / quick pricing ranges).

If you prefer a Private trial instead of Dedicated, tell us and we’ll swap the SOW outline.

Thanks — and happy to jump on a quick call tomorrow afternoon if that helps.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Cc: Alex Torres <alex.torres@medsys.ai>, procurement@medsys.ai
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo notes + deployment options recap (Medsys)

Aditya —

Thanks for the clear run-down. A few clarifying items from our side (answered inline):

> 1) Primary requirement: data residency (does Medsys need customer-managed keys / VPC?)

Yes — for any PII/PHI flows we must keep keys in our KMS and traffic must remain inside our AWS account (VPC peering or PrivateLink). That said, a non-PHI pilot could run on Dedicated.

> 2) Cutover tolerance: can you accept a 2–4 week mirror phase?

We would prefer a short mirror phase (1–2 weeks) if we can get strong parity testing and a rollback plan. Our ops window for cutover is June 7–21.

> 3) Migration support: do you want Redwood to handle model conversion + KV cache migration or will internal infra team run that?

We'd like Redwood to handle the heavy lifting (conversion + validation) for the pilot. Internal team can shadow. Note: our current stack is a mix of vendor X API calls and a legacy GPU pool running a custom transformer — we will share constraints in an internal doc.

> 4) Procurement constraints: any fixed-term/PO requirements or integrations (DocuSign, SSO) we should surface now?

We need a standard PO, and DocuSign is preferred for contract signature. SSO via SAML is required for production.

Attaching our internal constraints doc.

Thanks — will loop in our infra lead if you can prepare a pilot SOW draft and a short ops runbook.

Jane Li
Head of ML Platforms, Medsys Health
jane.li@medsys.ai

Subject: Re: Post-demo notes + deployment options recap (Medsys)

Jane —

Appreciate the quick clarification. Looping in Priyom (Solutions) and Lauren (Sales Ops) to coordinate SOW and procurement/PO expectations. A few internal asks so we align the SOW: 

- Priyom: given Medsys needs KMS-in-customer-account + VPC private connectivity for PHI paths, recommend we propose a split pilot: Dedicated for non-PHI endpoints + VPC-enabled Private trial for a single PHI workflow (short-lived). Thoughts on feasibility and required engineering effort?

- Lauren: procurement notes — can we offer DocuSign + standard PO flow? Also need to confirm typical billing cadence and whether we can accept Medsys' preferred net-30 PO.

I will draft a pilot SOW that includes: 6-week timeline, Redwood migration assistance for model conversion, 1-week parity testing, and a 2-week mirror window. If engineering thinks a 1-week mirror is OK (per Jane), we can compress.

For the pilot pricing, I suggest we present two options:
A) Dedicated pilot (3 reserved GPU nodes) priced as short-term committed capacity with a one-time migration fee.
B) Private (VPC) pilot with same committed base but includes network setup and KMS integration as line items.

Priyom — can you flag any blockers in the onboarding checklist (e.g., special PCI/PHI handling, HSM integration) and estimate effort hours?

Thanks team — I’ll attach the draft SOW in the next email and request a 1-hour runbook call with Medsys next week.

Best,
Aditya
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi Jane / Alex —

Following up with answers and next steps based on your constraints doc:

Quick answers:
- VPC/KMS: We can support customer-managed KMS + VPC peering or AWS PrivateLink. For PHI traffic we'll run through a private control plane (Private deployment) with a small control-plane proxy in your account for audit logs.
- Mirror phase: Per ops guidance, we can support a 1–2 week mirror. We will scope a 1-week parity run in the SOW with an optional extra week if parity issues surface.
- Migration support: Redwood will perform model format conversion, tokenization parity checks, and KV cache export/import for the pilot. We'll provide a validation checklist and run automated A/B tests to compare outputs.
- Procurement: We support DocuSign for signature and can accept PO-based billing (Net-30). Lauren will follow up with standard PO terms and required billing info.

Proposed immediate next steps (please confirm):
1) I will send a draft SOW by end of day Monday outlining Dedicated vs Private pilot options and a line-itemized estimate.
2) Schedule the 60-minute ops/runbook call next week (suggest Wednesday 5/20 or Thursday 5/21 AM PT).
3) You share any sample prompts or eval prompts we should use for parity testing.

Attachments: Redwood-SOC2-Summary.pdf (SOC2 scope we discussed), draft runbook link in Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/share/hosted-vs-dedicated-medsys-4721

If that sounds good I’ll include a short checklist in the SOW for the engineering onboarding tasks (VPC peering IPs, KMS ARN, SSO SAML metadata).

Thanks and talk soon,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
